messages:
oliver: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off the GCP billing/project + Shared VPC scaffolding for eu11-gpu. Draft runbook below, want a quick 👍 before I raise the infra PR.

maya: Thanks. What's the CIDR plan? we need to avoid collisions with existing regions.

sam: Also need GPU SKU availability and quotas confirmed before we spin anything up.

oliver: Initial plan was host-vpc 10.200.0.0/16 with service subnets 10.200.0.0/20 (gpu-1) and 10.200.16.0/20 (gpu-2). Reserved 10.201.0.0/16 for future.

tanvi: heads-up — eu7 already uses 10.200.0.0/17. that will overlap. suggest moving eu11 to 10.210.0.0/16. I'll verify in the IP catalog.

oliver: OK switching to 10.210.0.0/16 for host-vpc. Updating runbook now.

maya: Remember to include GCP org policy and project labels: org_id, billing_account, env=prod, team=infrastructure.

oliver: Runbook (condensed):
1) Create GCP project: gcloud projects create redwood-eu11-gpu --name="redwood-eu11-gpu" --folder=FOLDER_ID
2) Link billing: gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-eu11-gpu --billing-account=XXX
3) Enable APIs: compute, compute.googleapis.com, iam, cloudkms, serviceusage
4) Create Shared VPC host project and attach service project:
   - terraform path: //terraform/modules/gcp/shared-vpc
   - host-vpc cidr: 10.210.0.0/16
   - subnets: 10.210.0.0/20 (gpu-a), 10.210.16.0/20 (gpu-b)
5) Create service accounts: redwood-infra@gcp-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com with roles: compute.admin, iam.serviceAccountUser, storage.admin
6) KMS: create key ring eu11 and key redwood-infra-key, grant cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to infra SA
7) Cloud NAT + routes: reserve static egress IP pool, configure NAT for subnets
8) Firewall rules: allow gke-master, inter-pod, healthchecks, ssh from bastion only
9) Monitoring: create stacks (ops-agent), alerting for gpu health, node cpu/memory, vpn down
10) Quota request: GPUs (A100), CPUs, persistent SSDs — open quota ticket with provider
11) Smoke test: create a test instance with accelerator and run nvidia-smi
12) Handoff: open PR, tag networking, ops, and schedule validation window

maya: Add KMS IAM snippet please — service account needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. Also enable CMEK for GCS buckets we use for model artifacts.

infra-bot: terraform plan //terraform/modules/gcp/eu11 on PR #482: Plan: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. Waiting for human review.

sam: Quota note — region eu11 might not have A100 in all zones. I'll check zone-level availability and file a formal quota request to cloud support. If A100 not present, fallback to A10G or multi-zone strategy.

tanvi: Smoke test commands (local):
```
gcloud compute instances create eu11-gpu-test --project=redwood-eu11-gpu --machine-type=n1-standard-8 --accelerator type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --image-family=ubuntu-2004-lts --image-project=ubuntu-os-cloud --zone=eu11-a --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa USER@$(gcloud compute instances describe eu11-gpu-test --zone=eu11-a --format='get(networkInterfaces[0].accessConfigs[0].natIP)')
# then run: nvidia-smi
```

oliver: Handoff checklist (to confirm before marking ready):
- [ ] Project created + billing linked
- [ ] APIs enabled
- [ ] Shared VPC host + subnets provisioned
- [ ] Service accounts + KMS created and permissions applied
- [ ] Cloud NAT and firewall rules configured
- [ ] Quota confirmed and ticket filed
- [ ] Monitoring alerts deployed
- [ ] PR opened and reviewers assigned
- [ ] Validation window scheduled

maya: Cost estimate ballpark: A100 on-demand ~ $2.50/hr (list — depends on region). Preemptible or spot can bring ~60% savings. Include monthly baseline with 2 nodes per pool for forecasting.

sam: I'll own the quota ticket and update here once support confirms. tagging @ops-sales for committed capacity / discount discussion.

tanvi: I'll run the validation tomorrow 09:00 UTC after the PR merges. Please ping me when infra-bot reports apply success.

oliver: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/482 — label `eu11-onboard`. Requesting reviews from @maya and @sam.

networking-tester-bot: VPC validation complete — no overlapping CIDRs detected, reserved ranges OK, route table sanity passed.

maya: :thumbsup: Looks good to go once quota confirmed and PR merged.

sam: Quota update: support replied — A100 available in zone eu11-a but quota needs increase to 8 GPUs. Submitted quota increase request, ETA 48h.

oliver: Thanks — leaving this thread open for final confirmation. I'll update the runbook with the 10.210.0.0/16 ranges and push the PR shortly.

tanvi: thanks — will run smoke tests and report back in this thread.
